deadline.value: The geoscience PhD deadline for fall entry is January 15, with funding consideration earlier.

also.quote: New students desiring financial support as a Teaching or Research Assistant must have applications on file in the Graduate College by December 1st

gre_general.value: The Dec 2024 Graduate College table lists no standardized test for the geoscience PhD.
gre_general.quote: Geoscience Ph.D. No N/A N/A N/A

gre_subject.value: Geoscience has no GRE subject test, and the handbook does not mention one.

supervisor.value: Admission is based in part on finding an advisor who has agreed to take the applicant, but not on that alone.
supervisor.quote: finding an advisor who has agreed to advise the applicant

funding.value: Support comes from assistantships, fellowships and grants; self-funded admission is a rare exception.
funding.quote: in rare cases (6) student can be admitted as self-funded

entry_route.value: Students can enter from a bachelor's (60 credits past it) or with a master's degree.
entry_route.quote: A minimum of 60 credits past the baccalaureate or bachelor's degree is required to earn a Ph.D. degree.

also.quote: Students who entered the program with a Master's degree

notes: Department website pages (geoscience.unlv.edu graduate and apply pages) returned HTTP 502 and are blocked; the 2026 Geoscience PhD handbook is used for quotes. Deadline is from the Graduate College table; the handbook funding deadline (December 1) is kept as time_sensitive.
